title: AIR STRIKE PROMPTS FOLLOW CHANGED BUTTONS
why: The controller air strike chord reads the bound previous slot and next slot buttons, but its two prompts were fixed text: after CHANGE PAD BUTTONS moved previous slot from LB onto Y, only Y + RB armed the strike while the ready line and the aim help CANCEL part still said LB + RB (and the aim help CALL button skipped the PlayStation names). Proven with eval: padBind(4,3) leaves airHint() at 'LB + RB'. Now both prompts build the chord from the bound buttons, pbn(4) + pbn(5), and the CALL button goes through padB; with default buttons the text is exactly LB + RB as before.
now: On a controller with changed buttons, the air strike prompts now name the buttons that actually call and cancel it.

edits.anchor: function airHint(){ return (typeof padOn==='function'&&padOn())?padB('LB + RB'):('PRESS '+keyLabel('KeyG','G')); }   // v27.43 (rvw1, cloud review 21): the key as it is bound
edits.replacement: function airHint(){ return (typeof padOn==='function'&&padOn())?padB(pbn(4)+' + '+pbn(5)):('PRESS '+keyLabel('KeyG','G')); }   // v27.43 (rvw1, cloud review 21): the key as it is bound; v16.xx (cloud-coop-air-chord-rebound), CLOUD HUNT 2026-10-15: the chord prompts name the bound buttons (pbn 4 and 5), not the default LB + RB

edits.replacement: c.font=hudFS(TYPE.micro); c.fillStyle=UIC.tx_2; hudText((padOn()?padB(pbn(7)):'LMB')+' CALL     '+(padOn()?padB(pbn(4)+' + '+pbn(5)):keyLabel('KeyG','G'))+' CANCEL',s.x,s.y-ar-U(8)); // v16.xx (cloud-coop-air-chord-rebound), CLOUD HUNT 2026-10-15: the chord prompts name the bound buttons (pbn 4 and 5), not the default LB + RB
